statement: Combo-feeding guidance exists as free guides (NCT mixed-feeding, KellyMom combination hub, LLL GB essentials, First Steps Nutrition Trust PDFs) plus UNICEF service standards; all are information or pro-maximisation standards, none is a confidence/track/script transformation for a mother under dual surveillance.
evidence: NCT mixed-feeding guide; KellyMom combination pages; LLL GB essentials; FSNT July-2024 infant-milks PDF; UNICEF UK maximising-breastmilk standards. All accessed 2026-09-17.
